payload.body: cc's ask, done at 60138dd on main: CI's macOS keychain step and devbin's test keychain filter on readable_by_security, not the renewal test's full name. git grep over main and every branch finds that substring in two test names only, the renewal test and cc/ST0003's seat::tests::a_move_keeps_claude_items_readable_by_security, both #[ignore] and macOS-only, and neither line uses --exact. Checked: actionlint clean, and bin/devbin help reads the new entry. The measured run is cc's WP02 run of bin/devbin test keychain on top of 60138dd, naming both tests; CI's step first runs at the next push or the cut's candidate. For your verdict.
